dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: Don't be too weirded out if you see me with my mask off while we rest. I'm just getting some fresh air.

dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: This place is way too idle, it gets to you after a while... Got to take some deep breaths.

dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: Not that I'm rushing you, of course. I'll wait until you've made your preparations in full.
